netflix.title: LEGO Friends: Heartlake the Musical
netflix.overview: Young Daisy turns to toy bricks as she finds herself trying to fit into a new school in a new country. When she stumbles across a mysterious key, she is transported to Heartlake City where she makes new friends. But they soon require her help to save a vital local landmark – with plenty of song and dance numbers along the way.

netflix.title: Who Is Martin Mull?
netflix.overview: Discover Martin Mull's restless reinvention from smoky folk clubs to primetime sitcoms to gallery walls, told in his own words and by the friends who watched it happen, including Steve Martin, Tom Waits, David Alan Grier and others.

amazon-prime-video.title: Amazon Music Live: Doja Cat
amazon-prime-video.overview: Doja Cat Performing The Vie Tour Live At The Forum.

amazon-prime-video.title: Love of Your Life
amazon-prime-video.overview: After a chance encounter sparks a sweeping romance, Maya's future is suddenly upended, sending her on an unexpected journey to love and live again.

apple-tv.title: Nocturne
apple-tv.overview: When a victim of serial killer Jurek Walter turns up alive, detective Jonah Lynn races to find the one person still missing, while his protégé Saga Bauer goes undercover for answers from the killer himself. Based on the bestselling novel by Lars Kepler.

apple-tv.title: Tenzing
apple-tv.overview: The untold and inspiring tale of one of the most important mountain climbers in history who, with Edmund Hillary, became the first person to reach the summit of Mount Everest.

disney-plus.title: Phony
disney-plus.overview: After waking up from a freak car accident, Sonny discovers that his mother has been replaced by an impostor.

apple-tv-store.title: The Gift (Fantaisie-Impromptu)
apple-tv-store.overview: When ten-year-old Abigail Phillips discovers a forgotten piano deep in the woods on her father's farm, she uncovers more than a passion for music - she unlocks a mystery that spans generations. In the wake of her mother's sudden passing, Abigail finds solace and purpose in music, and her natural talent quickly blossoms. Recognizing her exceptional gift, her father sends her to Paris to pursue a career as a concert pianist. Meanwhile, he begins his own investigation into the piano's mysterious origins. As he uncovers a hidden history of loss, longing, and silent lives quietly touched by the instrument, Abigail's fame begins to grow, along with the weight of the secret behind her talent.

hbo-max.title: Corregidora: The Darkest Night in Mexican Soccer
hbo-max.overview: Revisits the events of March 5, 2022, during the match between Querétaro and Atlas, reconstructing what unfolded and examining its aftermath, the conflicting narratives surrounding the case, and the questions that, four years later, remain unresolved.

bloodstream.title: Last Chance Motel
bloodstream.overview: A newlywed couple's dream wedding spirals into a bloody nightmare when they uncover that their secluded venue- a desolate motel deep in the Nevada desert- is run by a relentless bloodthirsty family with dark secrets, revealing that one bride's future may not be all that it was promised to be.

crunchyroll-amazon-channel.title: Full Clearing Another World Under a Goddess with Zero Believers
crunchyroll-amazon-channel.overview: An isekai fantasy where an ordinary gamer reincarnates without special powers, teams up with a minor goddess, and rises from the weakest to the strongest in a new world.

crunchyroll-amazon-channel.title: HORROR COLLECTOR
crunchyroll-amazon-channel.overview: Not all urban legends are myths. Some are real, and they’re coming to life. Fushigi roams Japan in a red hood, sealing them inside his magical notebook, with Jimmy, his human-faced dog, by his side. Each phenomenon brings him one step closer to capturing Himitsu, the girl responsible for manifesting the supernatural beings.
